placements.why: Both statements read the late ferry timetable against observed ridership: the weekday last sailing moves earlier because it carries under ten passengers, while the weekend timetable stays because Friday and Saturday late sailings still fill. This is a subject that future ferry-timetable decisions will keep feeding. The existing leaf holds tool-library opening hours, a different service and domain, so it is not reused. It is cited as a loosely parallel shape through the lineage link.
placements.title: Late ferry sailings run where passengers actually ride
placements.frame: What does the evidence of how many passengers each late sailing carries say about which sailings the ferry timetable should keep, move, or leave alone?

weighed.why: The nearest placed leaf is Narrative_LateSailingsFollowRidership. The position's statements concern tool-library Saturday opening and volunteer staffing, which says nothing about ferry sailings or passenger counts, so it does not support that leaf.
